the rest is tips: Shopify's help-centre section Setting up tipping options for online orders (SH-I-2109) is held, cited by no cell, its concern SH-C-047 landing only in CM-CHK-001, the coarser capability where a tipping capability would sit; no tipping statement held for the other four (searched tip, tips, tipping, gratuity; for Salla and Zid إكرامية, الإكرامية, إكراميات, بقشيش, البقشيش; outscope on all five); detail: whether each change (an edit, a return, a cancellation, a fee such as Salla's cash-on-delivery fee in CM-PAY-029@salla) is recorded as its own record apart from the money, for the model's detail at ORD after GM; whether Sharrwah records each change as its own record apart from the money is engineering's, an architecture decision; what an invoice records and how a duty is added to what a buyer owes, in each market, is S-05's (tax and invoicing)

detail: how each platform holds the amount still owed and whether its payment status is stored or derived: Zid keeps paid or unpaid apart from the order status, unpaid taking in pending, refunded and voided (ZD-C-028/boundary/ZD-S-0725); Shopify lets an order be over-refunded (SH-I-0886); no statement held names an outstanding balance (searched outstanding, balance due, amount due, net payment, partially paid, financial status, المبلغ المستحق, مدفوع جزئي); whether Sharrwah holds one signed balance and derives every status from it is engineering's design, an architecture decision

detail: the kinds of due date (at checkout, on receipt, net days, a fixed date, on fulfilment, a deposit and scheduled parts) and what happens when a part falls due: Shopify's payment_schedules/due event (SH-C-045/boundary/SH-S-6081) and its Payment reminder notification template (SH-I-2027, held, cited by no cell, its concern landing in CM-NTF-001); no statement held for a deposit on payment terms (searched deposit, remaining balance, billing policy, checkout charge, عربون, دفعة مقدمة, الدفعة المقدمة); instalments in parts, on which provider's terms in each market, are S-04's (the pilot's Decision 13 moved to it, S-01 S01-D13)

detail: each obligation's records outside the order, for the model's detail at LOY, PAY and PLN after GM; whether one money model holds them all is engineering's design, an architecture decision (architecture/plan.md section 3, money records), bound by the founder's decision of 26 October that a holder's ledger of balances, holds and payouts is a part separate from an order's payment record (a reading of how it binds); ruled: Sharrwah's own fees live in a billing part separate from sellers' payments (S-01 S01-E3, engineering's, not vetoed); the seller's debts to Sharrwah and how they are collected are S-11's; whether Sharrwah's own company holds stored value or lends (balances, financing) is on the founder's list
